cohort_nesting: narrow_mainland is a strict subset of intermediate_mainland is a strict subset of full_mainland; they differ mainly in controls (419 / 429 / 439 cases). Agreement across cohorts is a sample-selection sensitivity analysis, not replication.
markers: hla.typing.v2 results/06.assoc_inputs/<cohort>/{allele,residue}_dosage.tsv, read unchanged (md5 checked against summary.json); 2-field alleles and amino-acid residues at IMGT positions; 0/1/2 copies, blank = undetermined
coding: VCF hard calls, REF A = copy does not carry the marker, ALT P = copy carries it; effects are per copy carrying the marker
positions: chromosome 6, gene start (RefSeq hg38_refGene, union of chr6 transcripts) + rank of the marker within its gene; labels, not physical residue positions
fixed_model: plink2 --glm omit-ref no-firth hide-covar --ci 0.95 on the 12_model_inputs fixed_model sample set (relatives removed); complete case per marker
random_model: SAIGE step 2 (--LOCO=TRUE --chrom=6 --AlleleOrder=alt-first --is_Firth_beta=FALSE --impute_method=mean --maxMissing=0.15 --minMAC=0.5) on the reused analysis/assoc_saige 'main' null model (full GRM, LOCO, SEX + 10 PCs), all phenotype samples
random_model_p: p = p.value.NA (no SPA), as in the genome-wide SAIGE scan; p_spa = p.value kept as a secondary column; se = 1/sqrt(var), consistent with p.value.NA; OR = exp(BETA)
significance: Per (cohort, class, model): Bonferroni p < 0.05 / markers tested; Benjamini-Hochberg q < 0.05 over the same family (missing P counted as 1). Not corrected across cohorts or models. lambda_GC reported, never applied.
independence: designed and run without reading any file, script, null model or result of analysis/assoc_hla
figures: results/figures/0N.<family>/, four families in reading order, one README.md per family
